授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: 本講義では、批判的な心で読み、考え、発表し、報告するといった、学術コミュニケーションの基本的な技術を習得することを目的としています。技術論文の読み方だけでなく、批判的な書き方も学びます。また、文献調査を行うことも推奨する。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: This course is designed for students to acquire the basic techniques for scholarly communication, such as reading, thinking, presenting, and reporting with a critical mind. Students will learn how to read as well as write a technical paper critically. The students will also be encouraged to conduct a literature review. All students will write a complete paper.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: critical thinking, critical writing, how to make your arguments effectively
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件: You must be able to take all the coursework.

授業科目の成績評価の方法について.レポート:
Term paper: 45%
A: Clearly identifies the essence of the topic, a strong logical progression from the problem’s introduction, analysis and to its conclusion/solution
B: Main ideas are clear; s/he demonstrates a logical progression from the problem’s introduction analysis and to its conclusion/solution
C: Identifies the essence of the topic with some logical progression from the problem’s introduction analysis and to its conclusion/solution
D: Main ideas are unclear; s/he poorly identifies the essence of the topic; a poor logical progression from the problem’s introduction, analysis, and to its conclusion/solution
F: Plagiarism or non-submission; Does not demonstrate the minimum understanding of the topic.
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.その他:
Peer reading: 10%
Active participation in class activities like questions and comments/feedback during the presentation: 5%
Participation in class activities:
A: Always a willing participant, responds frequently to questions; routinely volunteers point of view of high relevance to the topics/questions
B: Often a willing participant, responds occasionally to questions; often volunteers point of view; understands the discussion topic.
C: Occasionally a willing participant, occasionally able to respond to questions; occasionally volunteer point of view
D: Rarely a willing participant, rarely able to respond to questions; rarely volunteers point of view; does not understand the discussion topic.
F: Absent for more than three classes (you cannot submit your final term paper.)

授業科目に関する学習相談について.合理的配慮について:
障害(難病・慢性疾患含む)があり、通常の方法による授業を受けることが困難な場合には、教育目的の本質的な変更など過重な負担を伴わない限り、合理的配慮を受けることができます。合理的配慮とは、教授・学習法の変更、成績評価の方法の変更、授業情報の保障(資料の字幕化、個別の資料配布、録音・撮影の許可)、受講環境の調整などを指します。実際の方法については担当教員と建設的対話を行った上で決定されます。
